newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares rise at last, outlook uncertain.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares rise at last, outlook uncertain.

text.p: Danish share prices closed higher on Thursday as expected by the market with turnover up after a few desultory days but dealers saw the recovery as possibly shortlived.

"The rise was more or less as we expected if somewhat delayed but turnover looks healthier again. Early falls in New York point however to no continuation of the Danish share index rise," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index closed 0.78 point up at 152.66, while the KFX June future rose 1.00 point to 151.90 with 12 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
Among KFX paper, Tele Danmark and Unidanmark were the most traded.
The former finished five crowns up at 345, echoing interest in the share in the United States, while the latter closed unchanged at 329.
Overall turnover for the day was 1.116 billion crowns.
